confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates, not checked against live menus, hostel or hotel listings, or booking pages. Argentina's peso-linked and inflation-driven pricing is volatile, so USD figures could be well off. Restaurant anchors are medium-confidence; the July 2026 winter ski-season effect on Ushuaia accommodation is uncertain, so the hotel and hostel anchors are the least reliable. Beer, cocktail and wine are estimated from general Patagonian tourist-town pricing and the beer-to-drink relationship, not direct price knowledge.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Patagonian tourist towns in Argentina, such as Bariloche and El Calafate, adjusted upward for Ushuaia's remote-destination premium, imported goods and higher accommodation demand. July is low-to-shoulder season outside the ski period, so accommodation is set to reflect winter ski-season demand.
